items.title: ‘The estrangement isn’t about politics’: My daughter hasn’t spoken to me for 4 years. Do I leave her a monthly annuity?
items.description: “You’ll have to trust me when I tell you that she had love, support and opportunities.”

items.title: SpaceX’s $100 billion spaceport plan has investors asking where all the money is coming from
items.description: The company will need to raise a lot of debt in order to fund its ambitions, according to an analyst.

items.title: ‘It’s the ultimate regifting’: My mom gave me a house. Should I transfer it back to her to reduce capital gains?
items.description: “The property is very old and requires significant ongoing maintenance.”

items.title: We’re in our 50s and have $1.5 million in traditional 401(k)s. Is it too early to start Roth conversions?
items.description: “The last adviser we worked with lost a significant portion of our portfolio.”

items.title: Does a 2% beneficiary inherit 100% if the 98% beneficiary dies in a car accident? Asking for a friend.
items.description: “I’m curious what would happen if the account owner were to die suddenly at the same time as the 98% beneficiary.”

items.title: A new tax on these companies would help Washington shrink the deficit
items.description: This month, the U.S. Treasury Department made two ominous announcements: that it will no longer require shell companies to identify who owns them, and that the U.S. federal debt has hit $40 trillion.

items.title: Is my wealth manager’s fee too high? I’m paying 1.2%, but he’s not doing much.
items.description: “He doesn’t seem to be protecting me from market downturns.”

items.title: Salesforce’s stock rockets 20% and gives the software sector a major lift
items.description: Salesforce’s earnings showed that AI isn’t killing traditional software, and that the operators of major AI models are willing to strike partnerships with legacy vendors.

items.title: How Foot Locker went from a sneakerhead destination to a store struggling to get rid of old shoes
items.description: Dick’s Sporting Goods has faced challenges fixing Foot Locker since acquiring it last year. Some skeptics are asking: “Why buy it in the first place?”

items.title: My father-in-law passed away, leaving a house with tenants. Do I evict them?
items.description: “We don’t know whether they have signed leases or are renting month to month.”
